# apple_certificate (Resource)

Creates a signing certificate from a certificate signing request (CSR). Destroying it revokes the certificate, which invalidates the provisioning profiles that use it. Certificates cannot be renewed in place; use `early_renewal_hours` with `create_before_destroy` to replace one before it expires. Import it by its App Store Connect ID or serial number.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# The private key never leaves Terraform: App Store Connect signs the CSR.
resource "tls_private_key" "distribution" {
  algorithm = "RSA"
  rsa_bits  = 2048
}

resource "tls_cert_request" "distribution" {
  private_key_pem = tls_private_key.distribution.private_key_pem
  subject {
    common_name = "Example Distribution"
  }
}

resource "apple_certificate" "distribution" {
  certificate_type = "DISTRIBUTION"
  csr_content      = tls_cert_request.distribution.cert_request_pem

  # Replace the certificate 30 days before it expires.
  early_renewal_hours = 720
}

# For a type without a per-team limit, such as DEVELOPMENT, create the new
# certificate before revoking the old one. Distribution certificates are
# limited to one of each type per team, so they must be revoked first.
resource "apple_certificate" "development" {
  certificate_type    = "DEVELOPMENT"
  csr_content         = tls_cert_request.distribution.cert_request_pem
  early_renewal_hours = 720

  lifecycle {
    create_before_destroy = true
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `certificate_type` (String) Certificate type: `APPLE_PAY`, `APPLE_PAY_MERCHANT_IDENTITY`, `APPLE_PAY_PSP_IDENTITY`, `APPLE_PAY_RSA`, `DEVELOPER_ID_APPLICATION`, `DEVELOPER_ID_APPLICATION_G2`, `DEVELOPER_ID_KEXT`, `DEVELOPER_ID_KEXT_G2`, `DEVELOPMENT`, `DISTRIBUTION`, `IDENTITY_ACCESS`, `IOS_DEVELOPMENT`, `IOS_DISTRIBUTION`, `MAC_APP_DEVELOPMENT`, `MAC_APP_DISTRIBUTION`, `MAC_INSTALLER_DISTRIBUTION`, `PASS_TYPE_ID`, `PASS_TYPE_ID_WITH_NFC`. Changing it creates a new certificate.
- `csr_content` (String) PEM-encoded certificate signing request, e.g. `tls_cert_request.signing.cert_request_pem`. Changing it creates a new certificate.

### Optional

- `activated` (Boolean) Whether the certificate is activated. Changes are made in place.
- `early_renewal_hours` (Number) Replace the certificate when it is this many hours or fewer from its expiration date. The check runs during plan, so the certificate is replaced by the first apply after that point.
- `merchant_id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the merchant ID, for Apple Pay certificates. Changing it creates a new certificate.
- `pass_type_id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the pass type ID, for `PASS_TYPE_ID` and `PASS_TYPE_ID_WITH_NFC` certificates. Changing it creates a new certificate.

### Read-Only

- `certificate_content` (String, Sensitive) The certificate, base64-encoded DER.
- `display_name` (String) Display name of the certificate.
- `expiration_date` (String) Expiration date, in RFC 3339 format.
- `id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the certificate.
- `name` (String) Name of the certificate.
- `platform` (String) Platform of the certificate, if it has one.
- `ready_for_renewal` (Boolean) Whether the certificate is within `early_renewal_hours` of expiring, or has expired, so the next apply replaces it.
- `serial_number` (String) Serial number, in hexadecimal.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.12.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `identity` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = apple_certificate.distribution
  identity = {
    id = "2YK6R8T7VQ"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
### Identity Schema

#### Required

- `id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the certificate.

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# By App Store Connect ID or by serial number.
terraform import apple_certificate.distribution 2YK6R8T7VQ
terraform import apple_certificate.distribution 5A3F0B2C9D8E7F61
```
